page_title: AST 3-1 FUL | Aston Villa v Fulham 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Harrison Reed (Fulham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+6' John McGinn (Aston Villa) serves up a nice cross, but Bernd Leno punches the ball away.
90+4' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) picked up a yellow card from referee.
90+4' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Fulham are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
89' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header flew narrowly wide of the right post.
83' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
82' It's time for a substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) comes on in place of Willian.
82' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
82' The goal by Fulham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
82' Wait! Referee Simon Hooper has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
82' Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
81' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
80' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
80' Willian (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
78' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Harry Wilson (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
76' Fulham are ruled offside.
74' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Alex Iwobi (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
74' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
74' Substitution. Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) has come on for Raul Jimenez.
70' 3 - 1 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
69' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
69' Fulham fail to score from a corner as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.
66' What was Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
64' The referee can't ignore those comments and Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sees a yellow card for bad language.
64' 3 - 0 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
62' The referee signals a substitution. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Moussa Diaby.
60' That was close by Willian (Fulham)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
60' Wonderful movement by Fulham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
58' Willian (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
57' Excellent touch by Alex Iwobi (Fulham)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
54' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
52' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
49' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Silva decided to make a change. Bobby De Cordova-Reid is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

45' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

42' 2 - 0 John McGinn (Aston Villa) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0 with this magnificent strike.
41' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
41' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.
39' Willian (Fulham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
36' Simon Hooper blows the whistle, Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is penalised for a foul.
34' Aston Villa are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
31' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
27' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Antonee Robinson (Fulham), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
25' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
18' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
16' A lofted cross from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
13' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' The Aston Villa players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Simon Hooper. NO PENALTY!
8' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Aston Villa as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
8' Handball! A player from Fulham handled the ball. That's a penalty to Aston Villa! They have a good chance to score now.
7' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Bernd Leno.
6' The Aston Villa players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Tim Ream (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' A cross into the box from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared.

1' Aston Villa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper will supervise the game today.
